I am very fortunate to have many older female friends and yesterday one of my aunties taught me how to make laundry soap and I must share it with all of you.

You need:

  • 1 pot (~2 gallon)
  • 1 mixing bowl
  • 1 grater
  • 1 five gallon bucket (sturdy with center support) with lid
  • 1 cup super washing soda
  • 1 cup borax
  • 5 oz feldspar soap
  • Many Storage containers (2 quarts is nice size)

  1. Grate the feldspar soap to make it easier to desolve.

  2. Put grated soap into pot. Fill pot with water till it covers grated soap completely plus 2 inches.

  3. Turn grated soap and water to medium heat and allow to warm.

  4. While waiting, pour one cup borax and one cup super washing soda in mixing bowl. Break up lump and mix thoroughly.

  5. Fill up 5 gallon bucket half way with cold water.

  6. Return to grated soap. Water should be steaming. Stir till soap disolves.

  7. Remove melted soap from heat. Immediately add the borax/ washing soda mix and stir till dissolved.

  8. Add warm water to mix then add mixture to bucket.

  9. Carefully add hot water (faucet hot is fine) to bucket till bucket is filled 2 inches from top. If water too hot bucket may warp or crack.

  10. Stir the mixture till it starts to thicken a bit and bubble.

  11. Let mixture sit for 24 hours. Cover securely for safety.

  12. Stir mixture to soften it and poor into whatever containers you got lying round.

  13. Clean all the things.

Note: Soap will always need to be shaken or stirred before use. It smells a bit lemony. I feel it cleans better than what I usually buy in the store and no frankenstein ingredients.
